market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76,500 and 2026 low ~$60K. Reaching $50K requires another ~17% drop from the recent low (or ~35% from spot) within 8 months. Possible if macro risk-off intensifies but more demanding than the $55K case; consistent with a moderate bear continuation rather than the base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro deterioration causes a deeper retest of cycle lows
